script:
set -Eeuo pipefail
aws s3 cp s3://karpo-benchmark-20261119-115003-632930644527/inputs/vllm-single-development-01.tar.gz /tmp/karpo-vllm-development.tar.gz --region us-east-1 --no-progress
printf '%s  %s\n' '3dc7fc892c468f177017ba12eb6003cabad00d25d77fc35944e6cf3d63ec59fd' /tmp/karpo-vllm-development.tar.gz | sha256sum -c -
tar -xzf /tmp/karpo-vllm-development.tar.gz -C /opt/karpo
cat /opt/karpo/experiments/vllm-single-20261120/results/setup/install-exit-code.txt
/opt/karpo/venv-vllm034/bin/python -m pip install --no-deps /opt/karpo/serving/vllm_karpo
mkdir -p /opt/karpo/experiments/vllm-single-20261120/results/encoding
/opt/karpo/venv/bin/python /opt/karpo/scripts/vllm_karpo_encoding.py --checkpoint /opt/karpo/models/karpo-4b --experiment /opt/karpo/experiments/vllm-single-20261120 --output /opt/karpo/experiments/vllm-single-20261120/results/encoding/native.json
/opt/karpo/venv-vllm034/bin/python /opt/karpo/scripts/vllm_karpo_encoding.py --checkpoint /opt/karpo/models/karpo-4b --experiment /opt/karpo/experiments/vllm-single-20261120 --output /opt/karpo/experiments/vllm-single-20261120/results/encoding/vllm.json
cmp /opt/karpo/experiments/vllm-single-20261120/results/encoding/native.json /opt/karpo/experiments/vllm-single-20261120/results/encoding/vllm.json
aws s3 sync /opt/karpo/experiments/vllm-single-20261120/results/encoding/ s3://karpo-benchmark-20261119-115003-632930644527/results/vllm-single-20261120/encoding/ --region us-east-1 --no-progress
